name: @shepherd/app
description: The Electron shell: main-process wiring, preload bridge, React renderer.
//main: Electron's app loader reads `main` literally and never consults `exports`; workspace importers resolve through `exports` and never see `main`. So this field can be the built entry while the source stays the package's public face — neither has to lie.
//tabler: @tabler/icons-react is a DIRECT dependency below, not a re-export from @shepherd/ui. `Icon` takes a Tabler COMPONENT (`icon={IconPlus}`), which is what keeps the bundle tree-shaken — a barrel re-exporting the set would ship every glyph to every page that imports one primitive. This note lives at the TOP level and not inside `dependencies`, which is where it was: pnpm reads every key in that object as a package name and every value as a specifier, so `"//@tabler/icons-react": "A direct dependency, not a…"` installed a dependency FROM A DIRECTORY NAMED AFTER THIS SENTENCE and left `packages/app/node_modules/@tabler/icons-react` a dangling symlink to it. It survived because an older node_modules still held a good copy; the next `pnpm install` broke the renderer's typecheck with `Cannot find module '@tabler/icons-react'`, in a file nobody had touched.

scripts.dev: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node ../../tooling/scripts/build-daemon.mjs && env -u NODE_OPTIONS electron-vite dev
scripts.//package: The daemon build is NOT optional and belongs after `electron-vite build`, which empties `out/`. Without it the packaged app ships no out/daemon/main.js, every session fails to start, and the only symptom is a terminal pane that never prints anything — `pnpm dev` never notices because `dev` builds it.
scripts.package: env -u NODE_OPTIONS electron-vite build && node ../../tooling/scripts/build-daemon.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:dev: env -u NODE_OPTIONS electron-vite build --mode development && node ../../tooling/scripts/build-daemon.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --config.productName='Shep Night' --config.appId=com.shepherd.shep.night --config.mac.icon=build/icon-dev.icns
